summary: Restrict Naver login-status redirects to the exact account and login pages.

tasks.title: Restrict login-status redirects
tasks.change: Allow only HTTPS redirects whose parsed origin and pathname exactly match the account URL or login URL, and verify rejected redirect destinations are not fetched.
tasks.effect: Logout and unrelated Naver paths are aborted and login_status returns unknown; account and login destinations retain their status classifications.

verification.risk_reason: An unsafe redirect could trigger a logout request or other unintended navigation during a read-only login check.
verification.test_reason: The existing tests permitted broad Naver redirects and did not prove logout destinations were blocked before fetching.
verification.subject: Exact allowlist enforcement and abort-before-fetch behavior
verification.procedure: Run the three requested Vitest unit files.
verification.pass_criterion: Logout and other Naver paths are denied without destination fetches, while login and account pages classify correctly.

risks: Naver may introduce a new legitimate login redirect path, which would remain blocked until explicitly allowlisted.
